messages:
leo: 🎉 Heads up — we just crossed 75M inference calls across hosted this quarter. mini kitchen celebration at 3pm? donuts, sparkling water, and a very small gong?
anya: omg amazing!! huge congrats team :tada: when do we bring the kazoo squad vs confetti? :confetti_ball: 
sam: love it. will be remote — can we do a Zoom + GIFs for folks offsite? also suggest bagels + vegan option pls.
isabel: i'll bring mini croissants. also made a tiny cake with "75M" in icing 🍰
leo: @sam Zoom link posted in #general in 10. remote folks can use the same 3pm slot. @isabel you legend.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: 🎉 Metric milestone recorded: 75,000,000 calls. Congrats to team! (automated)
anya: poll: what should we do for noise level? 1) Gong & kazoo 2) Quiet clap 3) Paper confetti. vote with emoji.
sam: 1) :thumbsup: for Gong & kazoo (ready to annoy building)
isabel: 2) :smile: prefer quiet clap (neighbors)
leo: 3) :tada: I'm fine with anything, as long as there's cake.
anya: also quick shoutout — @maria and infra crew for smoothing the autoscaling yesterday. huge clutch move.
sam: big props to infra!! :rocket: @maria you rule
maria: thanks! team made it easy. quick note: please avoid large alpha releases during next peak window (we'll post schedule).
anya: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/teamwork-win-3o7aD2saalBwwftBIY
isabel: remote folks: we'll send a care-package voucher. check your email.
leo: ok mini agenda for 3pm: 5 min toast, cake cutting, 2-min team selfie, then back to work. see you there 🎈
ops-bot: reminder-bot: calendar invite sent to #random @channel
sam: :raised_hands: can't wait. good job team.
